answer: A reef-grown river escrow: a new identity earns nothing until its work is genuinely used downstream. Each job's output flows along a public river ledger and is paid only when an unrelated downstream consumer attests it used that output in real work, staking 8 POA on the claim. A karst of fakes cannot fake downstream use: escrow doubles per extra identity from the same operator, so the first fake locks 8 POA while the tenth locks 4,096 POA, plus a $3 audit per job. Idle fakes earn zero.
